required_source_behavior.purpose: deterministically construct the complete explicit content-addressed input specification consumed by the frozen N0 provenance source; do not produce an N0 receipt, population ledger, registered-file inventory or session manifest
required_source_behavior.root_policy: accept every root and source path explicitly; resolve canonical absolute paths descriptor-safely; reject symlinked or aliased roots and path changes; never discover an input root
required_source_behavior.metadata_tables: require exactly the 13 frozen v1.0-trainval table paths; reject extra, missing, duplicate or noncanonical tables; record byte SHA256, size, row count and canonical aggregate digest
required_source_behavior.upstream_release_receipt: require a separate explicitly addressed machine-readable upstream-origin receipt that binds release name, acquisition source, archive or extracted-directory identity and all metadata table content addresses; an unverified sidecar, pathname or asserted release label is insufficient
required_source_behavior.devkit_identity: bind explicit package version, distribution metadata, official splits.py bytes and a credential-free upstream repository/ref or immutable source receipt; hash only the explicitly enumerated required package files and forbid ambient package discovery
required_source_behavior.official_split: parse and normalize only the explicitly addressed official split source; bind its byte hash and resulting ordered train/val scene-name sets; forbid fallback or locally invented split lists
required_source_behavior.token_reachability: derive every candidate sensor, map and CAN path only by traversing the explicitly addressed trainval metadata graph from trainval log/scene/sample tokens; never walk or list shared samples, sweeps, maps or CAN directories
required_source_behavior.sealed_test: reject metadata tokens, scene names, paths or source rows outside the explicitly frozen trainval release; do not open a path until trainval reachability and channel/linkage are proven
required_source_behavior.registered_files: emit an ordered explicit path/address expectation for every reachable six-camera and LIDAR_TOP sample_data frame/sweep plus reachable map and CAN file; record expected type, size and SHA256 using streaming descriptor-safe reads
required_source_behavior.input_specification: emit one canonical strict JSON object containing all explicit roots, source identities, expected content addresses, table counts/digests, split identity and ordered file expectations required by script 60
required_source_behavior.self_validation: round-trip the staged input specification through the frozen strict input loader and reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, Boolean integers, non-finite values, noncanonical JSON or any omission/substitution
required_source_behavior.publication: write only to a caller-selected absent private staging/output directory, validate and re-read all staged bytes, then atomically publish without replacement; failure leaves no accepted output
required_source_behavior.resource_boundary: stream hashes and use bounded table/token indices; no persistent cache, model artifact, checkpoint, accelerator dependency or data copy/materialization

required_synthetic_attacks: ambient directory discovery, glob, recursive walk or shared-root listing
canonical root replaced by the DiffusionDrive symlink alias
missing or unverified upstream release receipt and sidecar-only substitution
missing, extra, duplicate, renamed, swapped or changed-during-read metadata table
installed devkit version, RECORD, METADATA, splits.py or repository identity substitution
test-release scene, token or file injected into trainval reachability
unreachable sensor, map or CAN path and directory-wide inventory substitution
missing camera, LIDAR_TOP frame/sweep, map or CAN expectation
symlinked, escaping, non-regular, duplicate or changed-during-read registered file
asserted size, count, digest or path substituted for an observed value
unknown field, duplicate JSON key, Boolean integer, non-finite value or noncanonical output
input specification accepted without frozen script-60 round-trip
pre-existing output, partial write, staged mutation and post-validation mutation
explicitly_not_authorized: reading any real nuScenes or NAVSIM metadata table, archive, sidecar, sensor, map, CAN, info-PKL or raw-data content
creating a real input specification, hashing real dataset/devkit contents or selecting a real input/output artifact root
real N0 provenance receipt, population ledger or registered-file inventory generation
real session-atomic manifest or membership generation
dataset materialization, info-PKL generation, anchor fitting or cache creation
model import, checkpoint access, T0, CUDA, GPU, training, evaluation or final-test access
performance claim, controller promotion, publication, push or 06G dispatch
movement, rewrite, amendment, reset or rebase of any accepted, RC, research, recovery, controller or public ref
next_gate: controller audit of the exact one-commit synthetic/source-only input-builder candidate; only a later separate authorization may permit construction of one real content-addressed input specification
